sorghum: gdd_to_silking_c (half-bloom) is null: K-State gives ~1,500 °F GDD half-bloom → maturity on a 42 °F base (KSU_SORGHUM_GDD), but no planting → half-bloom value on the 10/30 °C method was sourced tonight
sorghum: gdd_to_maturity_c is null for the same reason; the sensitive window is therefore not evaluated for sorghum
sorghum: frost_free_days_needed is null: depends on hybrid maturity and planting date; K-State notes stress-delayed maturity raises frost exposure (T1_SORGHUM_GUIDE)
sorghum: heat_threshold_c 35 is a common screen, not a sorghum pollen-viability threshold
sensitive_heat_above_normal_years: a phase has fewer than 10 complete 1991–2020 sensitive windows (or no window), so above-normal heat is not evaluated for it.

Each phase uses the same harvest-year weather range; annual metrics average phases, not separate phase-specific year subsets.
Demand is potential ET₀ × Kc. Supply is rain plus the annual allocation; no application losses or stored soil water are credited.
Calendar low-cover months are equivalent months outside crop dates, not observed bare soil. Residue and winter dormancy are not inferred.

Autumn-sown winter crops use prior-year weather; frost-free duration is not a valid winter-survival model, so winter frost risk is unavailable. Calendar Kc does not model vernalization or winter dormancy.

winter_wheat: gdd fields are null: winter wheat development (vernalization, dormancy) is not modelled with summer-crop GDD; use the calendar sensitive window
winter_wheat: kc.stage_days are a proportional scaling of the Idaho row, not a published Great Plains row
winter_wheat: heat_threshold_c 32 °C is a screening value between K-State's ~82 °F and ~91 °F statements
winter_wheat: Establishment water after corn harvest is not modelled (agronomy rule T1_R05_WHEAT_HANDOFF)
frost_risk: 0 of 35 requested years evaluated; incomplete years are excluded, not zero.
corn → winter_wheat: calendar overlap; planting precedes the previous harvest. Confirm or adjust planting dates before using this sequence.
POWER is regional context (~50 km), not a field measurement; root-zone wetness is model-based MERRA-2.
Crop demand is ET₀ × Kc, not metered pumping or OpenET.
Historical water and heat comparisons hold the current crop and planting calendar fixed. Water status compares rain minus demand before irrigation.
Daily irrigation timing is unavailable; no daily bucket is inferred from a seasonal total. A reported total appears only at the final chart date.
